prompts.browser: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one production-quality desktop UI concept at 1440 x 1024 for Ovela Files, a self-hosted personal/family Drive alternative. Reference image attached is ONLY brand/material inspiration, not layout to copy. Keep its warm ivory textured paper, restrained sage/amber/clay/blue pigments, four-square Ovela logo, crisp rectangular shapes, subtle dimensional glass buttons, clear Arial-like typography. No Manage link. ONE shared header: Ovela logo left, Search files middle, Isaac and a rounded-rectangle sample avatar right. This screen is 'My files': one narrow sidebar My files / Shared with me / Recent / Starred, Trash lower, subtle storage meter footer. Main area generous margins, breadcrumb My files, sage glass '+ New' and quiet Upload controls, compact grid/list switch. Primary content a beautiful efficient TABLE not a pile of cards. Columns Name, Owner, Modified, Size. Rows with elegant small dimensional filetype icons: folders Documents, Projects, Shared with family; files Mountain weekend.docx, Household budget.xlsx, Autumn plans.pptx, Cabin.jpg, Garden walk.mp4, Notes.md, settings.json. Real readable density, thin row separators. One selected Projects folder row has quiet sage tint, no giant details card. Small two-person sharing icon on shared folder. Current date September 5 2026, use simple 'Today' / 'Yesterday'. No marketing heading or welcome statement. Screenshot fills frame edge to edge, no browser chrome, no outside caption, no nested cards. This is FILE BROWSER only, not multiple screens. Faithful beautiful Ovela visual family.
prompts.office: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE realistic production-quality desktop UI screenshot at 1440 x 1024 for Ovela Files OFFICE DOCUMENT EDITOR. Attached image is brand/material inspiration only. Match warm ivory paper, sage/amber/clay accents, four-square Ovela logo and slim square-edged buttons with subtle glass bevel. ONE thin shared app header: Ovela logo left, breadcrumb Files / Documents / Mountain weekend.docx center-left, Saved quietly near filename, 'Share' small sage glass button and Isaac sample rounded-rectangle avatar right. Below this one shared header is a plausible embedded Collabora-style office editing toolbar, clearly functional not reinvented: File Edit View Insert Format Tools, then font family, 11pt, bold italic underline, alignment, undo redo. This toolbar is editor-specific, not a second app header. Main central white paper page with faint warm shadow on pale parchment workspace. Document heading 'A weekend in the mountains', a landscape photograph of an alpine lake, a short introduction and 'The plan' with three short day-by-day paragraphs. Right edge one slim comments gutter with a small realistic comment 'Let's leave early on Friday.' and a reply field. Do NOT invent complex custom office ribbons or theme controls. Understated status footer 'Page 1 of 2' and 100% zoom. Page text stays black because document is printable. Nice contrast, generous whitespace, no cards nested within cards, no global sidebar swallowing document width, no marketing. This is specifically a DOCX editing example of an editor which will also support XLSX and PPTX; do not collage three editors into one image. No browser chrome or external labels. Date if needed September 5 2026.
prompts.preview: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE desktop 1440 x 1024 production-quality UI screenshot for Ovela Files MEDIA PREVIEW. Attached screenshot establishes Ovela logo, restrained earthy materials and typography, but preview is immersive dark mode. Deep green-charcoal #171e1b backdrop, light warm #f5f2e8 labels, sage glass accents, square/very slightly rounded edges. ONE minimal header: four-square Ovela logo, back arrow and Files / Trips / Garden walk.mp4, Share and Download quiet icons, rounded-rectangle sample avatar. Main focus a beautifully composed widescreen paused video frame, lush forest trail with golden evening sun and a small wooden bridge. No blur on media. Native-feeling clean play/pause, scrubbing progress 00:32 / 02:18, volume and full-screen controls in a translucent bottom strip inside the viewer. Below the video a slim horizontal filmstrip, adjacent photos lake.jpg and cabin.jpg and selected Garden walk.mp4, no separate cards or app dashboard. Previous / next arrows near viewer edges, top-right small Info icon closed. No file metadata panel open by default, no welcome copy, no second header, no excessive chrome. High contrast controls clearly distinguishable over video. Concept demonstrates one shared preview experience for images and videos, but only ONE selected video shown. Edge-to-edge screen, no browser/device frame. Current date September 5 2026 only if needed.
prompts.code: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity 1440 x 1024 desktop UI screenshot for Ovela Files lightweight CODE EDITOR. Match attached Ovela brand reference with four-square logo, refined warm materials, but use richer dark palette: charcoal green #171e1b background, sage, warm amber, muted bright aqua and clay syntax colors, ivory text. ONE app header Ovela logo left, Files / Projects / home.ts breadcrumb/title, right small sage-glass Save button, quiet Share icon, rounded rectangle sample avatar. Small file tree only, 220px wide, Projects expanded with home.ts selected, settings.json, README.md and assets folder. Main editor is calm, large and readable monospace code, line numbers, syntax-highlighted TypeScript: export type AppLink = { name: string; url: string; }; then const apps: AppLink[] = [{ name: 'Photos', url: '/photos' }, { name: 'Files', url: '/files' }]; then a short export function returning names. About 20 lines, wide empty breathable space to right. One small tab home.ts, neighboring settings.json tab. Tiny footer TypeScript, UTF-8, Ln 8 Col 12. NO terminal, debugger, git sidebar, AI pane, extension marketplace, pretend code execution, or complicated IDE chrome. This is a file editor with pretty syntax, simple save, and reliable text editing. Subtle dividers and one shared surface; no nesting cards. Crisp screenshot, no device frame, no marketing copy. Date if used September 5 2026.
prompts.markdown: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop UI screenshot 1440 x 1024 for Ovela Files MARKDOWN LIVE PREVIEW EDITOR. Attached image is Ovela brand inspiration: warm ivory textured paper, elegant restrained sage and earthy glass accents, four-square logo, charcoal Arial-like UI, crisp rectangles. ONE top header: Ovela left, Files / Notes / Home lab.md breadcrumb/title, small Saved indicator, Share glass button and sample rounded-rectangle avatar right. A slim left file tree Notes with Home lab.md selected, Ideas.md, Weekend.md. Main writing canvas fills remaining space with an unboxed readable document, max 680px line length and generous margins. Document renders '# Home lab' as a large beautiful heading with NO visible hash because inactive. Below it a rendered paragraph 'A quiet home for everything we make and keep.' Then a section rendered 'This weekend', two elegant Markdown task checkboxes and a linked phrase 'Photo library'. The ACTIVE paragraph at insertion cursor visibly reveals raw Markdown, e.g. 'Keep **original files** portable and easy to back up.' with the actual ** syntax visible only on that selected line and quiet sage line highlight. Rest of document remains prettily formatted. Render a small block quote lower down 'Make the useful things feel at home.' Need express Obsidian-like live preview in ONE pane, not split raw/preview panes. Tiny top editing controls undo redo and a clear Live preview / Source segmented toggle with Live preview selected. No giant formatting ribbon, no kanban, graph view, side comments or AI. User-owned real .md concept. No cards nested in cards, no second app header, no device/browser chrome. Date if needed September 5 2026.
